adapt: one compatibility block at the top of the file, the tessellation case's spelling, the texture table's 256 slots and the viewport state's shape. dm/gfx/nvn/nvn_obj.h is this host's ABI, so the fork's OP_COPY_IMAGE_STRIDE (39) is named OP_XBG_COPY_IMAGE_STRIDE here, the nine OP_COUNT_+N cases ride on OP_XBG_SYNC_WAIT..OP_XBG_TYPED_CLEAR (52..60, after our OP_COUNT_ = 51), and case OP_COUNT_ (the fork's patch size) is spelled OP_XBG_PATCH_SIZE: 51 is our sentinel and no command of ours is 51. OP_BIND_TEX takes slots 0..255 (nvn_obj.h, NVN_SEPTEX_SLOT0 and the shaders' reflection), so tex is [6][256] and the two descriptor readers that capped at 128 take 256. OP_VIEWPORTS records n viewports at first, so the single viewport became viewport[16] with depth_range[2] (DEPTH_RANGE overrides the record's near/far), viewport_n counts them and the consumers use index 0; n > 1 is still refused (pending: a pipeline with that many viewports). depth_clamp, rast_discard, restart on/index and the viewport swizzles are state in PipeMemoKey's restart range wired into pipeline rasterization/input-assembly state (depthClampEnable, rasterizerDiscardEnable, primitiveRestartEnable). The draw, dispatch and texture-copy cases now read this host's records instead of the fork's: OP_DRAW / OP_DRAW_IDX go through draw_rec / draw_idx_rec and send ind / mdi_cnt to draw_indirect() (which reads the arguments at execution), OP_DISPATCH expands ind, and OP_COPY_T2T branches on DM_COPY_RESOLVE to resolve_texture(). The 12 missing handlers are implemented in execute(): OP_CLEAR_BUF, OP_DEPTH_CLAMP, OP_RENDER_COND (with skip checks in draws and clears), OP_FENCE_SYNC, OP_TF_BIND, OP_TF_STATE, OP_RAST_DISCARD, OP_VP_SWIZZLE, OP_BIND_TEX1 (via bind_rec), OP_PRIM_RESTART, OP_BIND_UBO_SMALL (via bind_buf_rec), OP_BIND_VBUF1 (via vbuf_rec). dm/gfx/vk/engine_smoke/opcode_map.txt maps every opcode and payload_mismatch.txt the payloads.
